classification: Exact boundary-equivalence construction; explicitly synthetic and lossless. No grid replay or hardware validation.
meaning: Distinct internal phase histories remain invisible even to exact direct PCC sensing when P/Q at every nodal boundary coincide. This is a conceptual internal decomposition, not a newly calibrated benchmark load model. First-order PCS feasibility is analytic: command=b+tau*db/dt.
